edges.reason: msg.sender provides the buyer identity and the token payer in buy
msg.sender provides the buyer identity in the multiBuy loop
msg.sender must equal the ticket owner to receive the claim payout
msg.sender must own every ticket in the multiClaim batch
enterDrawingPhase allows msg.sender == owner() to bypass the time gate
drawing allows msg.sender == owner() to bypass nextDraw, enabling unauthorized early draw
reset is guarded by onlyAdmin comparing msg.sender to adminAddress
adminWithdraw is guarded by onlyAdmin against msg.sender
adminWithdrawSafe is guarded by onlyAdmin against msg.sender
owner or modifier onlyOwner validates msg.sender in setAdmin
block.timestamp gates drawing (nextDraw) and seeds randomness, making the draw miner-influenceable
block.timestamp >= nextPharse controls who can enter the drawing phase and when
reset reads block.timestamp to reschedule nextDraw/nextPharse and record lastTimestamp
internalBuy observes block.timestamp when updating the lottery schedule
block.timestamp is written into lastTimestamp, propagating timestamp dependence to the random seed
buy performs an external token transferFrom to an arbitrary ERC20 while state accounting has just been updated
multiBuy performs an external token transferFrom after mutating per-user and per-issue accounting
claimReward performs an external token transfer to msg.sender after settling the ticket
multiClaim performs an external token transfer after looping over the ticket set
adminWithdraw executes the external token transfer for the admin
adminWithdrawSafe computes and executes the external excess-balance transfer
drawing uses inline assembly modulo to derive winning numbers, guarding against out-of-range values
reset re-enters internalBuy to roll the remainBalance into the new issue
internalBuy mints a ticket NFT through lotteryNFT.newLotteryItem with the contract as owner
buy mints the caller's ticket through lotteryNFT.newLotteryItem calling back into the NFT contract
multiBuy mints each ticket through lotteryNFT.newLotteryItem inside the loop
claimReward makes an external call into lotteryNFT.claimReward before the token payout, allowing cross-contract reentry
claimReward computes the payout through getRewardView
claimReward depends on lotteryNFT claimInfo state to block double claims
multiClaim makes an external call into lotteryNFT.multiClaimReward before the token payout
multiClaim quotes each ticket reward through getRewardView
getRewardView derives the pool size from getTotalRewards
getRewardView divides by getMatchingRewardAmount, a possible division-by-zero / arithmetic risk
getRewardView reads historyAmount buckets and performs mul/div scaling that can round or revert
calculateMatchingRewardAmount aggregates userBuyAmountSum in unchecked uint arithmetic
_checkOnERC721Received performs a low-level functionCall enabling reentrant execution by an untrusted receiver
setAdmin writes a new privileged adminAddress controlled only by onlyOwner
setMinPrice mutates the price floor through onlyAdmin
setMaxNumber mutates the number bound through onlyAdmin
setAllocation mutates reward percentages through onlyAdmin, directly affecting payouts
initialize transfers ownership by calling initOwner
initialize stores the IERC20 token reference used for all transfers
initialize stores the LotteryNFT reference used for minting and claiming
initialize seeds lastTimestamp and the draw schedule from block.timestamp
drawing writes the four derived values into winningNumbers
drawing persists winningNumbers into historyNumbers for the issue
reset clears winningNumbers back to zero
_price flows into buy's accounting and token pull
_numbers flows into buy's range checks and index key generation
_tokenId selects the ticket settled by claimReward
reward local is the value transferred by claimReward
_externalRandomNumber is mixed into every keccak random seed in drawing
_randomNumber local holds the derived winning value written to storage
_tickets array drives the multiClaim ownership loop and payout sum
totalReward local is the aggregated value transferred by multiClaim
_adminAddress becomes the privileged admin in setAdmin
_numbers array drives multiBuy minting, validation and index key generation
_amount is the arbitrary value paid out by the privileged adminWithdraw
_issueIndex selects which historyAmount bucket getTotalRewards returns

normalization_plan.reason: The _price parameter exists only to drive buy's accounting; it has no independent semantic role and is folded into the buy node.
_numbers is a transient buy argument consumed by minting and key generation, so it merges into fn_buy.
_tokenId only selects the ticket inside claimReward and carries no standalone meaning outside that function.
reward is a short-lived local holding the payout amount inside claimReward and merges into it.
_externalRandomNumber is only meaningful as entropy for the drawing routine and is absorbed into fn_drawing.
_randomNumber is a scratch value produced and consumed within drawing, so it merges into fn_drawing.
_tickets is a transient batch argument for multiClaim and folds into that function node.
totalReward exists only as the accumulator feeding the multiClaim transfer and merges into it.
_adminAddress is the sole input that setAdmin writes to privileged state and is merged into fn_setAdmin.
_numbers is the looped purchase input for multiBuy with no independent identity beyond that call.
_amount solely parameterizes the privileged withdrawal and merges into fn_adminWithdraw.
_issueIndex is a pure lookup selector for getTotalRewards and is folded into that function node.
